WHY CHOOSE

Alwan Painting Services Pty Ltd

Quality. Experience. Reliability. A Bigger Team for a Better Result.

At Alwan Painting Services, we believe a long-lasting, professional finish starts with careful preparation, skilled workmanship and quality products. We provide residential and commercial painting services across Melbourne, with attention to detail at every stage of the project.

We use trusted, high-quality paints and coatings, including Dulux products, selected to suit each surface and project. From preparation through to the final coat, our focus is on delivering a clean, durable and professional finish.
